Low-poly and game-ready. 4096x4096px textures, several skins to choose from, low-poly pickup versions and ammo packs with different skins and texture mattes to further customize skins. Glowing and anodized barrels are included. Cyan versions can be used to easily change the hue in Photoshop. Models can be sub-divided in Blender if needed, they all have creases. Ideal for first person shooter games.  
Specs:

  - Several skins to choose from

  - Ammo pack with 2 different skins.

  - Skins with and without graphics

  - Low-poly version for weapon pickups and hero version for FPS perspective.

  - Shells are included, both, spent and unfired

  - All moving parts are separate so you can animate and rig in any way you like. Pivot points are situated in the hinges.

  - Skins are purposefully designed with colors that you can shift the hue of in Photoshop or Gimp, if that's not enough, mattes are included, so you can cut and paste colors and attributes from one skin to another to make your own.

  - Controls in Blender shader to add incandescence and anodization to the barrels

  - 4k textures for the weapon, 2k and 1024px for ammo.

  - Diffuse, Metal, Roughness, Normal and Emission maps

  - Everything is organized in easy to sort-through folders.

Formats included: .BLEND (Native) .OBJ .DAE, .FBX, .3DS

description_text:
BP History
BP PLC, formerly called Anglo-Persian Oil Company, Ltd. (1909–35), Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, Ltd. (1935–54), British Petroleum Company Limited (1954–82), British Petroleum Company PLC (1982–98), and BP Amoco (1998–2000), British petrochemical corporation that became one of the world’s largest oil companies through its merger with the Amoco Corporation of the United States in 1998. BP was initially registered on April 14, 1909, as the Anglo-Persian Oil Company, Ltd. It was renamed the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, Ltd., in 1935 and changed its name to the British Petroleum Company Limited in 1954. The name British Petroleum Company PLC was adopted in 1982. After merging with Amoco in 1998, the corporation took the name BP Amoco before assuming the name BP PLC in 2000. The company’s headquarters are in London.
The Anglo-Persian Oil Company was formed to take over and finance an oil-field concession granted by the Iranian government to an English investor, William Knox D’Arcy. The first successful oil wells were drilled at Masjed Soleymān, and crude oil was piped to a refinery built at Ābādān, from which the first cargo of oil was exported in March 1912. Other Iranian fields and refineries were built, and by 1938 Ābādān had the largest single refinery in the world. The concession was revised in 1933, briefly suspended in 1951–53, and renewed in 1953 in a consortium with other oil companies.
In 1914 the British government became the company’s principal stockholder and remained so. Effective January 1, 1955, British Petroleum became a holding company. Beginning in 1977, the British government reduced its ownership of British Petroleum by selling shares to the public, and in the late 1980s the government turned over British Petroleum entirely to private ownership by selling its remaining shares. This cleared the way for British Petroleum to acquire Britoil PLC, an independent oil company that produced oil from the North Sea fields.
British Petroleum developed oil fields and built refineries in several more countries, including major interests in Alaska’s Prudhoe Bay in the United States and in the United Kingdom’s sector of the North Sea, where British Petroleum made in 1965 the first commercial discovery of natural gas and in 1970 the first discovery of a major oil field. Beginning in 1970, BP merged its assets in the United States with those of the Standard Oil Company (Ohio), in which BP acquired a controlling interest. In 1987 BP acquired the remainder of the Standard Oil Company for almost $8 billion. In merging with U.S. oil giant Amoco in 1998, the newly created BP Amoco became the one of the largest petroleum concerns in the world. The corporation changed its name to BP PLC following the acquisitions, in 2000, of Atlantic Richfield Company (known for ARCO brand gasoline in the western United States) and Burmah Castrol (a leading British oil, gas, and lubricants company).In 2010 the offshore drilling rig Deepwater Horizon, owned by Transocean and leased by BP, exploded and collapsed, causing a rupture in the riser of a very deep oil well. An estimated 4.9 million barrels of oil were released into the Gulf of Mexico—the largest marine oil spill in history. The company subsequently paid billions of dollars in damages to individuals and businesses affected by the spill. In 2012 BP agreed to pay more than $4.5 billion in fines and penalties to the U.S. government and to plead guilty to 14 criminal charges. In 2015, as part of a civil trial, it agreed to pay some $20 billion.
BP and its subsidiaries and associated companies continue to engage in the exploration, production, refining, transportation, and distribution of oil and natural gas and in the manufacture of chemicals, plastics, and synthetic fibres. It operates convenience stores and filling stations through brands such as BP, Aral, ARCO, and am/pm.
In the late 20th century BP was a major investor in green energy, and in 2003 the company unveiled the slogan “Beyond Petroleum.” However, within a decade BP had scaled back its renewable energy efforts. Notably, in 2012 the company closed its solar energy unit.

P-51D Mustang: Bracket Assembly Rudder Trim Pulley Sta 311.5 Full Size 1:1
All parts; including nuts, bolts, washers etc; accurately modeled to original North American Aviation drawings and AN, MS, NASM specifications. description_text:
Ancient Rome Legionary Ship-Prow Tortoise Siege Machinery, used against hill towns. Faithful and accurate Reconstruction. C4D, 3DS, OBJ, VUE6-7-8-9-11!
______________________________________________
SmartCgArt is member of the Archaeological Institute of America [AIA].

Real World Scale Model [SmartCgArt Real World System]. Quads [C4D; OBJ] & Tris [VUE;3DS].

Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of an Ancient Rome Ship-Prow Tortoise Siege Machinery to create an Ancient Rome Ship-Prow Tortoise, according to the Scientific Data and the Archaeological Evidence.

Source: Apollodorus, Poliorketika [proteichisma and tortoise like a ship's prow].

The Ship-Prow Tortoise was used by legionaries during siege against hill towns, to protect troops from heavy objects rolled downhill: tree trunks, boulders, wagons and barrels.

It was used in combination with a wood and branches fence system, to defend deep ditches [1.5 m] were the soldiers could gather, before reaching the inner section of the tortoise where they stayed safe crowded, until the moment of the direct attack.

The Wood and Branches Fence System was used also independently to protect the ditches.

In the package you will find:
1- 1 Ship-Prow Tortoise;
2- 1 Wood & Branches Fence;
3- 13 Hi-Quality Hi-Def PhotoReal Textures [1700x1100; 1387x1272; 600x1600; 812x812];
4- Alternate Textures to create different types of elements;
5- Real World Scale SmartCgArt Man Reference System with models [C4D, VUE, 3DS, OBJ, DXF].

All the Models are prepared Hi-DEF and Photoreal, perfect for any type of Rendering!

POLYGONS/VERTICES COUNT [complete all models Package]
C4D-OBJ-POSER/DAZ: only/mostly quads [22171; 21112]
VUE-3DS: triangulated [39296; 21112]

Enjoy THE ARCHAEO.SYS 3D SERIES.

These models are useful for many types of sceneries, ancient sceneries but also modern ones, as for Roman re-enactment.

The Archaeo.Sys 3D series is developing high-fidelity 3D reconstruction of Objects, Architecture and Scenes from Classical Greek and Roman Antiquity.

description_text:
Description
Thanks to Storm, baristas are free to express themselves and explore their capacity for experimentation through simple and comfortable actions.Storm is research on values ​​that have been lost over time but re-emerged thanks to a new cultural and artisanal approach, which spread rapidly in the world. The coffee dispensed is at the center of every care. Baristas’ gestures the protagonists on stage and have a highly symbolic value. The relationship between those who operate the machine and who savor coffee is revolutionized: the barista who has chosen coffee beans, roasting and brewing with an almost maniacal dedication can offer ritual preparation and storytelling.
technical Description
This is Sabrina the traditional coffee machine from Astoria, I made it almost globally with editable poly, I leave it in Low poly with the modifier Turbosmooth in Render Iters for a better maneuverability in a big scene,  I try to name the models and groups and the materials. description_text:
Automatic machine AT-101M for the sale of sparkling water with and without syrup. Produced in the 80s in the USSR. 
The model was created in accordance with numerous references to match the original as much as possible.
Modeled in Blender. No 3rd party plugin needed.
Real world size. The size is shown on the screenshot.
All materials and parts are correctly named.
Some parts have Subdiv in levels 1 and 2.
Polycount without Subdiv modifier- 8093 verts, 7811 faces. With Subdiv in levels 1 and 2 -  60009 verts and  59380 faces.
All UVs are non-overlapping
2 materials and UV sets ( body and attachments) and 5 textures for each material : Normal OpenGL , Color,  Glossiness, Specular, AO. AO is not necessary for Cycles.
Textures - PNG 4096*4096 16 bit. I can provide another formats at your request (TGA, JPEG, PSD, etc.).
Only Blend file contains materials.
Exported files available with applied Subdiv modifier and without. Blend file has non-applied Subdiv for easy custom modeling.

description_text:
Low poly sci-fi heavy machine gun.
The scope, magazine, bullets, triger and eject button are separate objects and linked properly (for .fbx and .max formats). They are not animated but ready to animate.
All parts together have 1 UV map.
Objects have been unwrapped manually to use the space efficiently and UV mapped.
The pivot point has been located at zero point (x, y, z).
Modelled in 3ds Max and textured in Substance Painter, feel free to ask any request.
Formats: fbx, obj, max2017, glb.
Objects and textures have been named properly.
There are 3 color options (3 different Base Color textures).
2K and 4K textures are included (Textures: BaseColor x 3, Metallic, AO, Normal, Roughness, Emissive).
.glb formats are included (~3,5 MB each (3 color options), 1 draw call (all parts stable, can't be animated in glb format), 1 material, 2K textures).
You can see other sci-fi weapon models in my profile.

description_text:
Tech circuits TC1 is a set of 3D shapes that can be used for designing technological oriented visuals, ideal for motion graphics, sci-fi scenery or VJ clips. The pack contains 14 unique 3D shapes (circuits) and a 3D scene expressing a network of data circuits (cluster arrangement). The shapes have 3 different material ID’s applied and a multi-sub shader with 3 basic Octane materials applied. 
The package contains following items:

  - One 3ds max file version 2016 holding 14 unique 3D circuit shapes and basic multi-sub shader (no render settings)

  - One 3ds max file 2016 holding same shapes but setup for Octane Render version 4 (renders the presentation previews out of the box).

  - One 3ds max file 2016 holding a cluster scene depicting a circuit network, setup for Octane render 4 (renders the presentation previews out of the box).

  - 4 files for import to all major 3D software, FBX and OBJ files containing the separate shapes and cluster scene

Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the Author name on the right to enter his profile and then use the green contact button on the left to get to him). 
Have fun,

description_text:
An animated model of what we called a 'Cotton reel tractor' that we used to make as children. 
We used to make these from old cotton reels, by carving 'teeth' around both edges, then adding a piece of candle to act as a washer, then thread an elastic band through, with a matchstick at one end and a 'lolly-pop' stick at the other.
I have added a 'C4D motor' to this model, so it is animated. I have also made it interact with the (added) 'bumpy base'.
It was modelled in Cinema 4D and I have added an .FBX version too, all with lights, camera, materials and action...
I have also printed this model as a 3D printed working toy - You just need to add an elastice band and 'wind it up' and let it go...

description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model of wardrobe Industriart. It is a 3D copy of the real wardrobe of Russian manufacturer Industriart that makes industrial design furniture.  This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.... 
•        The well topology of middle-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
•        The model uses 2 materials - 1 for metal and 1 for wood. Material of metal uses 3 textures (Diffuse, Specular and Glossiness). Material of wood uses 1 texture (Diffuse).
•        The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. Dimensions of real wardrobe is W100xD50xH180cm (W39”xD19,7”xH71” inches). All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Middle-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our models with other furniture of this manufacturer.

Assuming no zero error, this is also the measurement.A micrometer (/maɪˈkrɒmɪtər/ my-KROM-i-tər), sometimes known as a micrometer screw gauge, is a device incorporating a calibrated screw widely used for accurate measurement of components[1] in mechanical engineering and machining as well as most mechanical trades, along with other metrological instruments such as dial, vernier, and digital calipers. Micrometers are usually, but not always, in the form of calipers (opposing ends joined by a frame). The spindle is a very accurately machined screw and the object to be measured is placed between the spindle and the anvil. The spindle is moved by turning the ratchet knob or thimble until the object to be measured is lightly touched by both the spindle and the anvil.

  - CalipersA caliper (British spelling also calliper, or in plurale tantum sense a pair of calipers) is a device used to measure the distance between two opposite sides of an object. Many types of calipers permit reading out a measurement on a ruled scale, a dial, or a digital display. But a caliper can be as simple as a compass with inward or outward-facing points. The tips of the caliper are adjusted to fit across the points to be measured and then the caliper is then removed and the distance read by measuring between the tips with a measuring tool, such as a ruler.

description_text:
Air compressor - Texture Set 2 -  Low Poly Model || PBR
Model is inspired by industrial garage.
================================================================================
Materials included in Blender. In order to work in cycles and EEVEE you need to assign all of the textures (different path).
No Third-party plug-ins used
Turntable of model rendered in Blender Cycles( worse quality for time improvement)
Technical properties:

  - Polygons = 11 500 ,

  - Vertices = 11 193 ,

  - Triangles = 21 994 .

Attached formats of an asset:

  - 
.BLEND_ Blender 2.8( Properly exported),

  - 
.FBX _Binary( Properly exported), 

  - 
.OBJ_ Wavefront( Properly exported) + .MTL _Material Template Library,

  - 
.STL_ Stereolithography( Properly exported),

  - 
.PLY_ Stanford( Properly exported), 

  - 
.ABC_ Alembic( Properly exported), 

  - 
.MDD _Lightwave Point Cache( Properly exported), 

  - 
.PC2 _Pointcache( Properly exported),

  - 
.DAE _ Collada( Properly exported).

Bare in mind that pbr materials to work properly need proper lighting and material setup. If you have a problem just ask.
RAR file contains:

  -  Height Map         4096 x 4096 px .PNG 16bit

  -  Normal Map       4096 x 4096 px .PNG DirectX 16bit

  -  Normal Map       4096 x 4096 px .PNG OpenGL 16bit

  - Glossiness Map  4096 x 4096 px .PNG 16bit

  - BaseColor Map  4096 x 4096 px .PNG  16bit

  - AmbientOcclusion Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 16bit

  - Metalness Map 4096 x 4096 px .PNG 16bit

I can provide a different archive format on request.
In the files high poly version included ( around 6 milion faces) - RAR file
Model is positioned at the beginning of the coordinate system (0,0,0) [Blender 2.8] Scale = 1:1:1 
Asset tested in:

  - 
Unity Engine (Unity 2018.1 (64-bit)) and (Unity 2018.2 (64-bit)) Also tested in Unity's LWRP and HDRP.

  - Unreal Engine 4

Please don't forget to like and follow me. If you need any other informations, feel free to contact me via email or check out my social media below. 
If you want you can visit my social media:

  - 
YT : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwREYcvQXueQAlNRbzK__Vg 

  - 
FB : https://www.facebook.com/SurfaceMaestro-3D-Print-Design-359282957918697/ 

  - 
IG : https://www.instagram.com/surfacemaestro.3/

Thanks and Good Luck Adventurer :)

This is a set of low poly barrels that will give your scene a nice look. Using a set of textures, you can customize them in any renderer. Features:

  - 3D Scene

  - Access to old version with high poly model 

  - Materials in C4D

  - 24 Textures (Includes: 2D View, Base Color, Roughness, Normal, Metallic, Height)

  - 442mb Textures (4096px) 

  - Supports with Unreal Engine (Partially)

  - UV Mapping

  - С4D, FBX, OBJ, 3DS, UASSET

  - Low poly model (Polygons 751),  In Scene (Polygons 21392) 

  - Bonus model high poly (Polygons 3050. No have texture)

  - Free Updates

  - Support Charity

If you like the model give a positive rating in ratings this will significantly affect future updates.
Support Charity
Upon reaching a sale in 100$/month, all subsequent sales from each model will be credited 10% to charities.

description_text:
Please, feel free to offer your price. Use the special button at the top right.
The Mecanum wheel is a design for a wheel which can move a vehicle in any direction. It is sometimes called the Ilon wheel after its Swedish inventor, Bengt Ilon, who came up with the idea in 1973 when he was an engineer with the Swedish company Mecanum AB.It is a conventional wheel with a series of rollers attached to its circumference. These rollers typically each have an axis of rotation at 45° to the plane of the wheel and at 45° to a line through the centre of the roller parallel to the axis of rotation of the wheel. Moving all four wheels in the same direction causes forward or backward movement, running the wheels on one side in the opposite direction to those on the other side causes rotation of the vehicle, and running the wheels on one diagonal in the opposite direction to those on the other diagonal causes sideways movement. Combinations of these wheel motions allow for vehicle motion in any direction with any vehicle rotation (including no rotation at all).
